turns.question: How many page views did customers make on our site on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no page-view metric; the closest is Customer actions filtered to the page_view action type, which was 5 on 1 October 2026 (that single day). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
